name: Calimals
description: An animal-friendly icon pack for the UI Icons module.
project_description:
The animal-friendly Calimals icon pack for UI Icons .

 Bring a touch of charm and friendliness to your Drupal interface with Calimals, the adorable icon pack designed to infuse your UI with animal-inspired warmth. 

 Features 
 
 Animal-friendly icons: A curated collection of icons featuring various animals, adding a friendly face to your user interface. 
 Seamless integration: Designed to work effortlessly with Drupal's UI Icons system, ensuring a smooth addition to your existing setup. 
 Versatile use cases: Ideal for content display and UI Patterns , allowing for creative flexibility across your site. 
 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module.
